name: Software Technology and Intelligence Research Lab (STIL)
institution: ETS Montreal (École de technologie supérieure), University of Quebec
department: Department of Software Engineering and IT
location: 1100 rue Notre-Dame Ouest, Montreal, Office A-4483

director.name: Ali Ouni

description: The STIL lab aims to design, develop, evaluate and deploy techniques and solutions to solve software engineering problems by leveraging artificial intelligence and data science methodologies to help practitioners enhance their software systems.
research_topics: Automating Software Development Using Artificial Intelligence
Technical Debt and Software Quality Assurance
Large Language Models for Software Engineering
